law.admission: Original P04 synthetic producer may execute while admitting, but verification must compare exact complete count/fraction geometry, six channel identities, source/release/risk/query/target/producer-evidence refs, selected-world contract and scope to code-pinned independently frozen P04 commitments BEFORE persisting. Bind admission witness to exact saved payload byte digest plus P01 B01E COMMITTED receipt/checkpoint and M2 subject, release, B5 selection. Freeze trusted witness outside caller-supplied editable bundle; local trust is contingent on separate custody of pin/checkpoint and excludes external authentication.
law.serve: Byte-verify saved artifact against exact pre-existing durable result ref, admission commitment and receipt; load exact saved bundle and validate complete count/fraction/root closure with pinned constants/commitment, compute conditional from saved raw values, verify saved numeric result and consumer receipts, and resolve local M2/B5. NEVER invoke producer constructors, select_world, run_progressive_chain, native synthetic builder, owner N10E/C1/F8 or call durable executor on serve.
law.trust_limitation: A caller who controls artifact, pin, admission witness, checkpoint and code can forge all local hashes; local code-pinned sourcefree oracle and independent previously committed bytes are not original-survey custody or external signature. No cryptographic claim beyond precisely stated trust root.
